title: EXAM ESCAPE
oneLiner: Dodge flying exam papers and grab lucky notes before the bell rings!
mechanics: Move the student around one screen while exam papers drift in from above.
Collect glowing cheat-sheet icons to score points.
Avoid papers, pencils, and ticking clocks; three hits end the run.
More hazards arrive and move faster as the timer climbs.

controls.a: Dash briefly in the current direction

lose: The student is hit three times or the exam bell timer expires.
scoring: Collect glowing notes for points, with bonus points for streaks.
